```{=html}
<div class="naf-hero" id="naf-home">

  <div class="naf-hero-main">
    <p class="naf-hero-kicker">NAF 2008–2025 · Nomenclature d'activités française</p>
    <p class="naf-hand-heading naf-hero-title" role="heading" aria-level="1">La NAF est un arbre</p>
    <p class="naf-hero-sub">
      Explorer les activités <strong>du général au très précis</strong> —
      des 22 sections jusqu'aux 747 sous-classes, dans les deux nomenclatures.
    </p>

    <div class="naf-versions" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Version de la nomenclature">
      <button type="button" class="naf-version is-current" role="radio" aria-checked="true"
              data-version="2025">NAF 2025</button>
      <button type="button" class="naf-version" role="radio" aria-checked="false"
              data-version="2008">NAF 2008</button>
    </div>

    <form class="naf-home-search naf-searchbox" id="naf-home-form" role="search" autocomplete="off">
      <label class="naf-visually-hidden" for="naf-home-q">Rechercher un code ou une activité</label>
      <svg class="naf-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
        <circle cx="9" cy="9" r="6"></circle>
        <line x1="13.5" y1="13.5" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
      </svg>
      <input id="naf-home-q" type="search" class="naf-search-input"
             placeholder="30.32Y, aéronautique, logiciel…">
      <button type="button" class="naf-search-clear" id="naf-home-clear"
              aria-label="Effacer la recherche" hidden>&times;</button>
    </form>

    <section class="naf-results" id="naf-home-results" aria-label="Résultats de recherche" hidden></section>

    <div id="naf-home-browse">
      <div class="naf-hero-actions">
        <a class="naf-home-cta" id="naf-home-cta" href="explorer/">
          Explorer la NAF <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
        </a>
        <a class="naf-home-cta naf-home-cta-ghost" href="explorer/visualisation.html?view=arbre">
          Voir l'arbre
        </a>
      </div>
      <p class="naf-home-counts" id="naf-home-counts" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="naf-hero-art" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 440 470" focusable="false">
      <!-- Rameaux latéraux estompés : les autres branches de l'arbre. -->
      <g class="naf-hero-twigs">
        <path d="M100 375 C 70 350, 48 340, 26 338" />
        <path d="M155 295 C 185 280, 205 278, 228 284" />
        <path d="M155 295 C 150 265, 158 248, 172 236" />
        <path d="M220 220 C 195 200, 178 194, 158 194" />
        <path d="M295 152 C 320 142, 336 142, 352 148" />
      </g>

      <!-- La branche suivie : NAF → C → 30 → 30.3 → 30.32 → 30.32Y -->
      <path class="naf-hero-vine"
        d="M70 455
           C 78 425, 88 400, 100 375
           C 116 342, 134 322, 155 295
           C 176 268, 196 244, 220 220
           C 244 196, 268 175, 295 152
           C 318 132, 340 110, 365 88" />

      <g class="naf-hero-node" style="--d: 0.25s">
        <circle cx="100" cy="375" r="6" fill="#2a669f" />
        <text x="118" y="380" class="naf-hero-code">C</text>
        <text x="134" y="380" class="naf-hero-lbl">Industrie manufacturière</text>
      </g>
      <g class="naf-hero-node" style="--d: 0.5s">
        <circle cx="155" cy="295" r="5.5" fill="#4a7cb0" />
        <text x="173" y="300" class="naf-hero-code">30</text>
        <text x="200" y="300" class="naf-hero-lbl">Autres matériels de transport</text>
      </g>
      <g class="naf-hero-node" style="--d: 0.75s">
        <circle cx="220" cy="220" r="5" fill="#6d95c0" />
        <text x="238" y="225" class="naf-hero-code">30.3</text>
      </g>
      <g class="naf-hero-node" style="--d: 1s">
        <circle cx="295" cy="152" r="4.5" fill="#8fadd0" />
        <text x="313" y="157" class="naf-hero-code">30.32</text>
      </g>
      <g class="naf-hero-node" style="--d: 1.25s">
        <ellipse cx="368" cy="84" rx="15" ry="7.5" fill="#a9c2dd" stroke="#2a669f"
                 stroke-width="1.6" transform="rotate(-40 368 84)" />
        <text x="356" y="62" class="naf-hero-code naf-hero-code-leaf">30.32Y</text>
      </g>

      <g class="naf-hero-note naf-hero-node" style="--d: 1.4s">
        <text x="52" y="180" class="naf-hero-hand">suivez</text>
        <text x="52" y="204" class="naf-hero-hand">une branche</text>
        <path class="naf-hero-hand-arrow" d="M96 214 C 120 232, 146 240, 176 240" />
        <path class="naf-hero-hand-arrow" d="M162 232 L 178 240 L 164 250" />
      </g>
    </svg>
  </div>

</div>
```
